stories.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
stories.summary: An ongoing phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" impersonates major brands, including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX, to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials using fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars. [...]
stories.rookie: Fake emails, texts or calls that trick people into handing over passwords or money.
actions: Pull any sender domains or URLs and check them against client mail logs.
Remind clients they can forward suspicious email to report@phishing.gov.uk (SERS).
Watch for lookalike domains of client brands (typosquats).
enrich_steps: Sector (Charity) → tag every client in that sector and send them a short heads-up
